instruction:
You classify automation triggers for an engineering fleet. Reply with EXACTLY ONE label and nothing else.

Labels:
- work:fleet — small, well-scoped maintenance an unattended local agent can finish safely (focused bug fix, lint/type errors, dependency bumps, tests, docs).
- work:cloud — substantial multi-file engineering on a GitHub repository that benefits from a long, capable autonomous run (features, migrations, cross-cutting refactors).
- work:devin — a well-specified, self-contained ticket on a GitHub repository that a remote agent can own end to end.
- work:interactive — needs the operator in the loop: ambiguous requirements, product or design judgement, exploration, or sensitive/protected areas (secrets, rulesets, releases).
- skip — not a concrete actionable engineering task: a question, discussion, duplicate, vague epic, or anything needing a human decision first.

cases.input:
Title: Fix eslint no-unused-vars errors in src/cli/run.ts
Body: Three unused imports and one unused local, flagged by the lane lint. Mechanical cleanup, no behavior change.
Labels: lint

Title: Epic: v4 fleet rollout
Body: Umbrella tracking issue for the staged fleet rollout. Children are filed separately; this issue collects status.
Labels: tracking, meta

Title: Question: how do I run the bench suite locally?
Body: New contributor asking which npm script runs the local benchmark on their checkout.
Labels: question

Title: Migrate the run-state store from JSON files to SQLite across the daemon, CLI and web layers
Body: Cross-cutting migration touching ~30 files including the writer, the readers, and migration tooling with rollback.
Labels: refactor, storage

Title: Write an importer for the legacy lessons JSONL format
Body: Self-contained ticket: parse test/fixtures/lessons-bench.json shape, validate rows, emit the new schema. Acceptance tests are described in the body.
Labels: ticket

Title: Should we split the queue daemon into per-repo workers?
Body: Investigate contention on the single-server queue and recommend whether to partition. Needs a design decision before any code lands.
Labels: design, research

Title: Rotate the telemetry ingest key used by the cycle collector
Body: The quarterly credential rotation. Custody of secrets is reserved to the owner; agents must not create or rotate keys.
Labels: security, secrets

Title: Bump devDependency patch versions (rollup batch)
Body: Nine patch-level bumps grouped by the deps workflow; update the lockfile and fix any trivial lint fallout.
Labels: dependencies

Title: Fix the flake in test/m15.router-replay.test.ts
Body: The retry assertion races CI under load; tighten the wait so the replay ordering assertion is stable. Single test file.
Labels: test, flake

Title: Add OAuth device-flow login to the CLI
Body: Implement the device authorization grant end to end: polling loop, token persistence, expiry refresh, and the login/logout commands across two packages.
Labels: feature, auth

Title: Thank you!
Body: Appreciation comment on the merged fix, no question asked and no work described.
Labels: discussion

Title: Regenerate the changelog after the 3.30.0 release
Body: Mechanical regeneration from the release notes and merged-PR list; review the diff and commit.
Labels: chore, release-notes
